record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare METAL_CLAW: Galarian Meowth (1 star) and Perrserker (2 stars, which also has the passive STEELY_SPIRIT, not covered here); both maxPP 70, range 1. The strategy is shared; the unit differences are the star count (table index) and Perrserker's passive.
record.summary: Single-target TRUE damage plus a self attack buff. The strategy keeps requiresTarget = true. It deals 10 / 20 / 40 / 80 (by the caster's stars; Galarian Meowth 10, Perrserker 20) as TRUE damage to the target (scaled by the caster's AP and by critPower if the cast crits; ignores def and speDef and the item / effect reductions that skip TRUE; at least 1 and rounded up; shields absorb first), then raises the caster's own attack by 2 / 4 / 6 / 12 (Galarian Meowth 2, Perrserker 4) scaled by AP and crit and adjusted by a held Big Eater Belt. The attack buff does not depend on the damage landing (a protected or bounce-protected target blocks the damage but the caster still gets the buff).

targeting.who: the single target of the cast (damage); the caster itself (attack buff)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is not overridden, so the base default true applies; the cast uses the target passed to process.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. handleSpecialDamage (apBoost default true) multiplies by (1 + caster AP/100), x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed), x1.2 if either side has STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT, and on crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x factor (factor 1 for TRUE: Rocky Helmet and Black Augurite reductions do not apply to TRUE). Then handleDamage: x2 if the attacker is enraged, field and other attacker/target multipliers, no defense, rounded up, minimum 1.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> specialDamage (after AP, crit, etc.) -> reducedDamage (TRUE: no defense; ceil; min 1) -> shield absorbs first -> takenDamage reports shield damage plus HP damage capped at current hp. Blocked entirely (takenDamage 0, no death) by protect, skydiving or magicBounce on the target.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. Applied by addAttack (apBoost 1): round(requested x (1 + caster AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down to 0 digits) if held; Twist Band leaves a positive value unchanged; final atk = max(1, atk + applied).
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after AP, crit, belt) -> new atk. permanent = false (combat entity only). Applied after the damage call regardless of its outcome. Crit is rolled by castAbility only if the caster has ABILITY_CRIT.

buffs.applied: after AP, crit, Big Eater Belt and the min-1 clamp

starBehavior.note: 3 and 4 stars (damage 40 / 80, buff 6 / 12) are not reached at these units' factory star counts; whether other mechanics change a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond reaching the target in range 1.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored mode. Each cast adds the attack buff again (cumulative; no expiry coded in the strategy or in addAttack).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: TRUE damage 10 / 20 and attack buff 2 / 4 for the two units. Requested damage = raw; applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor (x other listed multipliers), then ceil and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is capped for the HP part. Requested attack buff = raw; applied = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor), then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down if held.
